widgets_values: Cinematic action sequence. Medium shot. A woman delivers a fast, high-impact high kick to a humanoid robot’s head. Motion is explosive and sharp. On impact, the robot’s head snaps violently backward; internal cables and wires stretch and partially tear, leaving the head dangling from the shoulders. The robot loses balance and crashes onto its back with rigid mechanical inertia. Immediate hard cut. Camera rapidly zooms into an extreme close-up of the damaged robot head: exposed wiring, sparks, unstable movement. The woman steps into frame, walks forward with controlled aggression, and forcefully stomps the robot’s head into the ground, crushing it flat. Debris, sparks, and metal deformation on impact. Fast, aggressive motion throughout. High temporal contrast. No slow motion. Strong physical reactions. Clear cause-and-effect physics.
